outcomes.name: blocked
outcomes.description: The executor reports that policy or a required prerequisite prevented completion.

outcomes.name: confirmation_required
outcomes.description: The executor reports that it stopped before mutation and needs explicit operator confirmation; authorization requires a typed plan result.

outcomes.name: degraded
outcomes.description: The executor reports useful information with weaker assurance or coverage than intended.

outcomes.name: error
outcomes.description: The executor reports that execution failed because of invalid input or an internal failure.

outcomes.name: finding
outcomes.description: The executor reports that the operation completed and found a security-relevant condition.

outcomes.name: not_applicable
outcomes.description: The executor reports that the operation is valid but unnecessary for the current subject.

outcomes.name: pass
outcomes.description: The executor reports that the operation completed as intended; this outcome alone is not proof of verification or mutation.

outcomes.name: unsupported
outcomes.description: The executor reports that a declared operation cannot be provided for the current harness or scope.
